fields.name: placed
fields.description: Ordered list of the colors of the cubes that have been put into the bin so far, one entry per completed 'put it into the bin' subgoal, oldest first. Empty list at step #1. At the decision step that directly follows an execution of B (the execution steps show a cube held in the gripper and then released over the bin, and the scene at the decision step shows the gripper open with nothing held), append the color of the cube that was held during that execution. Never append after a pick-up execution (one that ends with a cube held) and never after pressing the button. Count released cubes even if a cube of that color later appears somewhere on the table, since the bin is opaque and detections near it are unreliable. e.g. ["green", "green"]
